description: Install an add-on from a file. Beta builds only - this exists so the bridge can put a freshly built xpi in front of a running Thunderbird, which no WebExtension API can do.

functions.name: install
functions.description: Install the xpi at the given absolute path, upgrading in place when its id is already installed. Resolves once the add-on is installed.

functions.name: list
functions.description: The installed extensions, so a caller can tell which build is actually running.
